violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. No employee present during time of inspection, was a Food Safety Manager. Establishment must have employees trained as Food Safety Managers. New Violation. Correct By: 08/02/2026

Raw chicken wings was observed held at 55 degrees Fahrenheit on a chair by the three bay sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Chicken wings were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Knifes were observed stored on an unclean surface (between three bay sink and wall) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Knifes were washed in three bay sink during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. Establishment must purchase chlorine test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the fryolator have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non Food contact surfaces must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The chest freezer refrigeration unit is was observed with an excess of ice build up. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Establishment is to defrost chest freezer. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The hood system was observed with an excess of build up. Hood systems must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The chest freezer was observed with an accumulation of ice. Establishment is to run a defrost on unit. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025
